notes: Mr_Meat31 (carry) was alive and ahead in lane — a shove-and-rotate there flips a 1-2 into a numbers advantage.
Willy Guggenheim (midlane) was alive but losing lane and pinned — with them stuck across the map, this was the wrong fight to start.
We took Fangtooth in the same window — read it as a trade, not a clean loss.
🎮 private (offlane) was dead — went down 28s earlier, so this was never a full-strength fight.
We had the bodies (5v3) and it still went 1-1 — that's a fight to win with the man up.
Their main damage was Shinbi (27k magical); 2/5 of us itemized magic resist.
Enemy ran 2/5 on or near their meta core.

draftNote: 3 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Goldilocks324 (jungle→midlane), Cuban Noobster (offlane→carry), Xeebs (support→jungle).

coaching.headline: A proper win: the squad broke the base and finished the job.
coaching.team: Major objectives stayed with the squad, and the closing fights produced a demolished enemy base. The late outer-tower loss barely interrupted the finish; this was control with an ending, not endless foreplay around the river.

focus.title: Call the finish before the chase
focus.action: After the next won fight, the shot-caller should name the safest reachable structure and check the wave and team health; if the push is unsafe, call the reset immediately.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks did excellent objective work, but ward placement was poor despite useful clearing. Next game, place a ward on a safe objective approach before committing; the jungle cannot run on good intentions and a flimsy condom of vision.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 delivered strong carry damage. The late death is the moment to review. Next game, confirm nearby peel before advancing into enemy jungle and keep a safe route back to the team.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett supplied real defense and strong warding, but no objective damage. Next game, make the post-fight job explicit: guard the approach or hit the objective, then stick to that assignment.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy's Belica delivered strong damage with few deaths and contributed to objectives. Keep that shit. Repeat the follow-through next game: add objective damage after a safe fight win once the approach is covered.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs earned the praise on Steel: strong takedown contribution without a death. Vision denial deserves the next rep. Before an objective setup, check the contested approach with a teammate and clear reachable enemy wards.

20.4.call: A 3-1 kill cluster ended at 20:55; an enemy outer tower fell eleven seconds later. The follow-through mattered.

24.7.call: Five enemy deaths, no allied deaths in this cluster. Two inner towers and two inhibitors fell from 25:07 through 25:46. That was the decisive damage to the base.

27.8.call: Four enemy deaths without an allied death in the closing cluster. The Core fell at 28:33. Finish secured.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Wukong recorded strong objective damage while equipped with Manta Scythe, Infernum, The Perforator and Painweaver. No comparison here isolates their value, and the missing-magic-resist flag alone does not establish a build mistake.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher and Imperator match the recorded comparison core. Nothing in the death event establishes that a different item would have prevented it.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Mistmeadow Buckler, Terminus and Tainted Bastion differ from the comparison core. The mitigation total supports a defensive contribution, but cannot isolate item value or prove the build caused zero objective damage.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Caustica and Noxia were equipped. The performance supports keeping this as a useful baseline, not declaring the combination optimal or attributing the win to Caustica.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Fire Blossom, Xenia, Dynamo and Prophecy accompanied a deathless support game. That result does not isolate their individual value or prove the comparison core worse.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: This review does not model Steel's Eternal contribution; no claim about its effectiveness follows from these totals.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.0s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe
